ring = [(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,2),(2,1),(2,0),(1,0)]
frames = [{(0, 2): 'P', (1, 1): 'R', (2, 0): '+'}, {(1, 2): 'q', (0, 2): 'L', (1, 1): '+'}, {(2, 2): 'P', (1, 2): 'R', (0, 2): '+'}, {(2, 1): 'q', (2, 2): 'L', (1, 2): '+'}]
def step(p): return ring[(ring.index(p)+1) % 8] if p in ring else None
# P/q letter: moves one step clockwise along border, alternates P,q
letter = [ [ (p,s) for p,s in f.items() if s in 'Pq'][0] for f in frames]
for a,b in zip(letter, letter[1:]): assert step(a[0]) == b[0] and a[1] != b[1]
# arrow (R=right,L=left) and plus: each follows the path centre -> TR -> clockwise along border
path = [(2,0),(1,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,2),(2,1),(2,0)]
arrow = [[p for p,s in f.items() if s in 'RL'][0] for f in frames]
plus = [[p for p,s in f.items() if s == '+'][0] for f in frames]
apath = [(1,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,2),(2,1)]
assert arrow == apath[:4] and plus == path[:4]
nxt = {step(letter[-1][0]): 'P', apath[4]: 'R', path[4]: '+'}
opts = {'A':{(1,0):'q',(1,2):'+',(2,1):'R'}, 'B':{(2,0):'q',(2,1):'L',(2,2):'+'},
        'C':{(1,0):'P',(1,2):'+',(2,1):'L'}, 'D':{(2,0):'P',(2,1):'R',(2,2):'+'}}
good = [k for k,o in opts.items() if o == nxt]
assert good == ['D'], good
